citations.quote: Name: Lee Sin. Official role tags: Fighter, Assassin.
After Lee Sin uses an ability, his next 2 basic attacks gain Attack Speed and return Energy.

core_mechanics.summary: Ability casts empower subsequent attacks with attack speed and energy restoration.

cards.purpose: Recognize Lee Sin's fighting pattern and positioning threats.
cards.title: Lee Sin

citations.quote: After Lee Sin casts an ability, his next 2 basic attacks within a short time gain bonus attack speed and restore energy.

core_mechanics.summary: Casting an ability briefly empowers subsequent attacks with attack speed and energy restoration.

cards.purpose: Recognize why attacks between casts sustain his fighting pattern.
cards.title: Flurry

citations.quote: Lee Sin fires a sonic blast in the target direction that deals physical damage to the first enemy hit and marks them for a short time, during which they are revealed.

core_mechanics.summary: A directional projectile damages, marks and reveals the first enemy hit.

citations.quote: Lee Sin dashes to the nearby enemy marked by Sonic Wave, consuming the mark upon arrival to deal physical damage based on the target's missing health.

core_mechanics.summary: The follow-up dashes to the nearby marked enemy and deals physical damage based on missing health.

cards.purpose: Recognize the projectile mark and its follow-up dash threat.
cards.title: Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike

citations.quote: If the ally is a champion, both they and Lee Sin gain a shield for a short time upon his arrival and Safeguard's cooldown is halved.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Targeting an allied champion reduces Safeguard's cooldown.

citations.quote: Safeguard will not grant its shield if the dash is interrupted.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Interrupting the dash prevents its shield.

citations.quote: Lee Sin dashes to the target allied unit's location. If the ally is a champion upon arrival, both they and Lee Sin gain a shield for 2 seconds.If the target is a minion or ward, Lee Sin also shields himself.

core_mechanics.summary: Dashes to an allied unit and shields Lee Sin, also shielding an allied champion target.

citations.quote: Lee Sin can self-cast Safeguard to shield himself.
After Safeguard is cast, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will within a short time.
Lee Sin gains omnivamp for a few seconds.

cards.purpose: Recognize allied-unit mobility, shielding and the healing follow-up.
cards.title: Safeguard / Iron Will

citations.quote: Lee Sin deals magic damage to nearby enemies, marking them for a few seconds and, if they are not invisible when struck, revealing them.

core_mechanics.summary: Damages and marks nearby enemies, revealing targets that were not invisible when struck.

citations.quote: Lee Sin sends a wave to nearby enemies marked by Tempest, inflicting a decaying slow that lasts a few seconds.

core_mechanics.summary: The follow-up applies a weakening slow to nearby marked enemies.

cards.purpose: Recognize the close-range damage and conditional slow sequence.
cards.title: Tempest / Cripple

citations.quote: The displacement's direction is decided at the moment of impact
the only way for Lee Sin to control where his target is displaced is by using Flash before the cast time of Dragon's Rage ends

advanced_exceptions.summary: Flash during the cast can change the kick direction before impact.

citations.quote: Lee Sin roots the target enemy champion over the cast time, then roundhouse kicks them to deal physical damage and knock them back

core_mechanics.summary: Roots an enemy champion during the cast, then deals physical damage and knocks them back.

citations.quote: Enemies that collide with the displaced enemy while it is airborne take the same damage plus bonus physical damage and are knocked up for 1 second.

core_mechanics.summary: Collisions damage and knock up other enemies.

cards.purpose: Recognize the targeted kick and its collision threat to nearby teammates.
cards.title: Dragon's Rage

factual_risks: Supplied evidence does not provide base ability cooldowns.

No game patch label is established by the supplied evidence.

citations.quote: While the target is marked, Lee Sin can cast Resonating Strike.

relationships.condition: Sonic Wave has marked an enemy.

citations.quote: After Safeguard is cast, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will within a short time.
If Tempest hits an enemy, Lee Sin can cast Cripple within a short time.

section_disposition.reason: Primary Q card includes the projectile and mark.
The marked-target dash completes the same recognition sequence.
Primary W card includes allied-unit mobility and shielding.
Healing follow-up and ward targeting belong with Safeguard.
Primary E card includes nearby damage, marking and reveal.
The marked-target slow completes the same close-range sequence.
Primary R card teaches displacement and collisions; detailed exceptions remain outside central teaching.

summary: An overview and primary ability cards teach attack weaving, the marked-target dash, allied-unit mobility, the close-range slow sequence and kick collisions. Follow-up casts are merged with their opening abilities.
